adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 43 in AddGuestsDialog.tsx: `const message = \`${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}\`;` followed by `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error");`. The template literal will always produce a string (even if err.data?.code is undefined, it becomes 'undefined: ...'). Therefore, `message` is always truthy, making the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback unreachable dead code. This is a real bug where the intended fallback error message will never be shown.
